entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is very important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Yeah, well, I've been waiting for twenty minutes already. I need to speak to someone NOW!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah, how can I help you today?
I ordered a bike from you last week, and it arrived completely damaged! This is unacceptable!
I'm so sorry to hear that! Could you please provide me with your order number so I can look into this for you?
It's #VF-789234. The box was all beat up, and when I opened it, the bike had a *cracked frame*! A *cracked frame*! How am I supposed to ride that?

I understand your frustration. A cracked frame is definitely not what we want our customers to experience. To resolve this, I can offer you a full refund for the bike, and we will provide a *free label* for you to ship it back to us.

A refund? And I have to ship this massive thing back? What a joke! This is clearly *shipping damage*. Don't you guys have any quality control? What if it gets *shipping damage* again on the way back to you?
We apologize for the inconvenience, and we'll certainly do our best to make this right. The *free label* will cover the return *shipping damage*. Are you sure you don't want to exchange the item?

No! I wanted to use this bike this weekend. Now I'm stuck dealing with this. And to top it off, after I got it out of the box, I noticed a *wobbly wheel* too! It's like it was designed to fall apart. I don't want an exchange; what guarantee do I have that the next one won't be the same? I demand more than just a refund!

I understand your concern about receiving another damaged bike. To address the *wobbly wheel* in addition to the *cracked frame*, I can escalate this to my supervisor to see if there are any additional options we can offer, such as a partial discount on a future purchase. Would you like me to do that?
Escalate? How long will that take? I don't have all day to sit around waiting! I need this resolved NOW! This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced!
I understand your frustration. Escalation usually takes 24-48 hours for a response from the supervisor. In the meantime, we can process the return with the *free label* and the full refund.
24 to 48 hours?! Are you kidding me? This is ridiculous! I'm never ordering from VeloFit again! You can keep your stupid bike and your *free label*! I'm taking my business elsewhere!
I understand your frustration, is there anything else I can help you with today?
